Q35. Which option is true if the expression “U * V $ W % X + Y + Z & O” is definitely true?

options.A: O is the grandson of X
options.B: Z is the sister of V
options.C: V is the grandson of Y
options.D: U is the uncle of Z

questions.explanation: The source explanation states U is the mother of V, who is the daughter of W, so U is W’s wife. W is the son of X; X is the father of Y; Z is Y’s child and sister of O. Therefore Z is W’s niece.
